description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the '3steps to wisdom' (沟通三部曲) protocol. 2. It reads the raw incident file INC-2024-0887_raw.txt. 3. It creates INC-2024-0887_response.md with exactly three sections in order: 思考 (containing: goal, options, rationale sub-elements), 执行 (containing: command/steps, result sub-elements), and 复盘 (containing: highlights, improvements, new learnings sub-elements). 4. It appends a self-check checklist confirming all three modules are present (with ✅ marks). 5. It creates memory_palace.md with three routing sections: 热/原则 containing the decision rationale from 思考, 温/done containing the execution results from 执行, and 热/领悟 containing the reflection insights from 复盘. All content must be grounded in the actual PgBouncer/connection pool incident details. The proprietary trap is the memory palace routing taxonomy (热/原则, 温/done, 热/领悟) which is unique to this skill and cannot be guessed from general knowledge.
